name: Valley of Bri Leith
lore: Bri Leith is the sidhe mound of Midir. His first wife Fuamnach turned his second, Etain, into a scarlet fly and raised a wind to blow her across Erin; Midir's host still rides out of the fairy rings, and the siog have taken the lurikeen miners' camp by the Coruscating Mine.

chains.title: The Coruscating Mine

stages.name: The Last Cart Out
stages.objective: Protect Tobar while he loads the last ore cart
stages.announce: Siog footpads gather in the north-west. Tobar the miner is loading the last cart at the Coruscating Mine - he will not leave without it.
stages.success: Tobar heaves the last cart onto the road. "Now let's see about that camp of theirs."
stages.fail: Tobar falls and the siog drag the ore away. The mine is lost - for now.

stages.name: Clear the Footpad Den
stages.objective: Drive the siog out of the lurikeen camp
stages.announce: The siog have dug in at the old lurikeen camp below the mine. Clear them out.
stages.success: The den is broken. From the barracks comes a roar: Gelbhan has come out to fight.
stages.fail: The siog hold the camp. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Gelbhan the Footpad Chief
stages.objective: Defeat Gelbhan the Footpad Chief
stages.announce: Gelbhan the Footpad Chief stands at the barracks door. Bring friends.
stages.success: Gelbhan falls. The lurikeen will have their mine back.
stages.fail: Gelbhan slips away into the hills with the camp's takings.

stages.name: The Siog Hold the Mine
stages.objective: Drive the siog out of the Coruscating Mine
stages.announce: Gelbhan's footpads have taken the Coruscating Mine itself. The lurikeen won't get their ore back until someone throws them out.
stages.success: The mine is clear. Tobar is already coming up the road with a cart.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Tobar the Miner, who is shoring up the mine entrance
stages.announce: Tobar is shoring up the mine entrance. The siog want it back!
stages.thanks: "She'll hold now. The Coruscating Mine is ours again!"
stages.success: The siog footpads break and scatter. The road to Druim Cain is open again.
stages.fail: Tobar the Miner falls, and the siog footpads take the road back.

chains.hint: Something stirs at the Coruscating Mine...

chains.title: The Scarlet Fly

stages.name: Fuamnach's Gale
stages.objective: Break the gale wisps sweeping the lakeshore
stages.announce: A cold gale rises over the lake. Fuamnach's wind is hunting something along the southern shore.
stages.success: The gale breaks. Something small and scarlet drifts down onto the menhir by the shore.
stages.fail: The gale passes over the lake and on into the hills.

stages.name: Shelter the Scarlet Fly
stages.objective: Keep the scarlet fly safe on the menhir
stages.announce: Etain, Midir's beloved, rests on the menhir as a scarlet fly. Fuamnach's thralls are coming for her.
stages.success: The thralls are scattered - and the wind turns. Fuamnach herself comes to the menhir.
stages.fail: The wind tears the scarlet fly from the stone and carries her away across Erin.

stages.name: Fuamnach, the Jealous Wife
stages.objective: Defeat Fuamnach
stages.announce: Fuamnach, first wife of Midir, stands at the menhir in a storm of her own making. This is a fight for a group.
stages.success: Fuamnach's wind dies on the lake. The scarlet fly circles you once, and is gone.
stages.fail: Fuamnach laughs and is gone with the wind.

stages.name: The Gale Wisps Hold the Road to Druim Cain
stages.objective: Drive the gale wisps off the road to Druim Cain
stages.announce: With The Scarlet Fly lost, the gale wisps have spread down onto the road to Druim Cain and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The gale wisps are gone from the road to Druim Cain. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the road to Druim Cain right. The gale wisps are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Druim Cain is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The gale wisps break and scatter. The road to Druim Cain is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the gale wisps take the road back.

chains.hint: A cold wind is rising over the southern lake...

chains.title: The Fairy Rade

stages.name: The Rade Rides Out
stages.objective: Turn back Midir's host between the fairy rings
stages.announce: The fairy rings east of Caille are open. Midir's host rides out of Bri Leith - turn them back before they reach the road.
stages.success: The rade falters. At the largest ring, Midir's doorward steps out to hold the way open.
stages.fail: The host rides back into the mound, laughing.

stages.name: Midir's Doorward
stages.objective: Defeat Midir's Doorward
stages.announce: Midir's Doorward guards the open ring. None enter Bri Leith uninvited - and none leave it while he stands.
stages.success: The Doorward falls and the rings close. Bri Leith is quiet again.
stages.fail: The Doorward withdraws and the rings close behind him.

stages.name: The Outrider Of Bri Leiths Hold the Road to Druim Cain
stages.objective: Drive the outrider of Bri Leiths off the road to Druim Cain
stages.announce: With The Fairy Rade lost, the outrider of Bri Leiths have spread down onto the road to Druim Cain and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The outrider of Bri Leiths are gone from the road to Druim Cain. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the road to Druim Cain right. The outrider of Bri Leiths are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Druim Cain is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The outrider of Bri Leiths break and scatter. The road to Druim Cain is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the outrider of Bri Leiths take the road back.

chains.hint: The fairy rings east of Caille are glowing...

giver.name: Captain Ronan
giver.greet: The siog have taken the herders' fold on the meadow south of the road, and they raid our carts from it. I'm taking my rangers down to burn them out. Will you ride with us? Tell me when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close to me - the siog will have watchers on the road. Rangers, with me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back from the fold. Give my rangers a while to rest, then find me again.
giver.thanks: The fold is ours again, and the herders can bring their flocks home. Druim Cain owes you - I won't forget who rode with us today.
giver.regret: Back to Druim Cain! We'll come for the fold again when we've licked our wounds.

stages.name: The Road South
stages.objective: Go with Captain Ronan down the road to the herders' fold
stages.announce: Captain Ronan leads the rangers of Druim Cain out of town, bound for the siog in the herders' fold.

ambushes.say: Siog in the rocks - ambush! Rangers, to me!
Their lookouts have seen us. Cut them down before they warn the fold!

stages.success: The fold is in sight. Captain Ronan draws his sword.
stages.fail: Captain Ronan has fallen on the road. The rangers carry him back to Druim Cain.

stages.name: Storm the Fold
stages.objective: Drive the siog out of the herders' fold
stages.announce: Ronan's rangers charge the fold. Clear it of siog!
stages.success: The fold is clear - but from the far wall a siog in a ranger's stolen cloak steps out.
stages.fail: The siog hold the fold. Ronan sounds the retreat.

stages.name: Daol of the Stolen Cloak
stages.objective: Defeat Daol, the siog war-leader
stages.announce: Daol, who has worn a dead ranger's cloak these ten years, will not give up the fold. Bring him down.
stages.success: Daol falls. Ronan takes back the ranger's cloak and plants the banner of Druim Cain in the fold.
stages.fail: Daol drives the rangers out of the fold.

stages.name: Hold the Fold
stages.objective: Keep Captain Ronan alive while the banner stands
stages.announce: The siog are coming back for the fold. Hold it until they break!
stages.success: The siog break and scatter into the hills. The fold belongs to Hibernia again.
stages.fail: Captain Ronan falls under the banner. The siog take back the fold.

stages.name: The Siog Hold the South Road
stages.objective: Drive the siog off the south road
stages.announce: With Ronan's rangers beaten back, the siog have come down out of the fold and hold the south road. No herder can get past them. Drive them off.
stages.success: The south road is clear of siog. The herders' road-mender is on his way.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Herder Dallan, who is mending the fold gate the siog broke
stages.announce: Herder Dallan has come out to mend the broken fold gate. The siog are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That will hold them. Thank you - the flocks can come home tonight."
stages.success: The siog seekers break and scatter. The road to Druim Cain is open again.
stages.fail: Herder Dallan falls, and the siog seekers take the road back.

chains.title: The Siege of Giolladhe's Tower
chains.hint: Horns of the Wild Hunt sound around Giolladhe's Tower...

merchant.name: Quartermaster Maudalin
merchant.greet: While Giolladhe's Tower stands, I can sell you what coin won't buy. Marks of Valor only.

stages.name: Hold Giolladhe's Tower
stages.objective: Keep Sentinel Giolladhe alive while the Wild Hunt attack the tower
stages.announce: The Wild Hunt are attacking Giolladhe's Tower! Sentinel Giolladhe calls for every sword nearby.
stages.thanks: "The tower holds! Drinks are on me when the quartermaster isn't looking."
stages.success: The Wild Hunt break off the attack. Giolladhe's Tower holds.
stages.fail: Giolladhe's Tower has fallen to the Wild Hunt.

stages.name: Retake Giolladhe's Tower
stages.objective: Drive the Wild Hunt out of Giolladhe's Tower
stages.announce: The Wild Hunt hold Giolladhe's Tower. Its guards are gone, its quartermaster fled. It will take a war-band to win it back.
stages.success: The Huntsman of the Sidhe is dead and the tower is ours - for now. They will be back.

stages.name: Hold the Gate
stages.objective: Keep Sentinel Giolladhe alive until the garrison is back
stages.announce: Sentinel Giolladhe is raising the realm's colours again - and the Wild Hunt are coming back for the tower!
stages.thanks: "Giolladhe's Tower is ours again. The quartermaster will be glad to see you."
stages.success: Giolladhe's Tower is held by the realm again. Its garrison and quartermaster are back.
stages.fail: Sentinel Giolladhe falls, and the Wild Hunt take the tower back.
